D2 — Comparison board is open: review the three dashboard mockups and submit feedback.
Project/branch/task: design-ui-project on `main`, User Dashboard plan; mockups saved under ~/.gstack/projects/design-ui-project-97jhEm/designs/user-dashboard-20260912/.
Board URL: http://127.0.0.1:36281/boards/b-20260912-011653-w7si95/
ELI10: I generated three visual directions for the dashboard (activity feed primary, notifications secondary, quick actions under the heading) and all three passed the cross-model quality check. Rate them on the board, leave comments, remix elements you like, and click Submit. The variant you pick becomes the visual reference every review pass calibrates against.
Stakes if we pick wrong: the plan gets written around a look you do not actually want, and the implementer builds to it.
Recommendation: Submit on the board because it captures ratings, comments and remix specs in a structured file I read directly.
Note: options differ in kind, not coverage — no completeness score.
Net: board feedback is richer; typed feedback is faster; regenerate costs about 90 seconds per round.

options.label: Submitted on the board (recommended)
options.description:
✅ Ratings, per-variant comments and an overall direction land in feedback.json for me to read.
✅ Remix lets you combine the layout of one with the type or color of another.
❌ Requires the local browser tab; if you cannot open the URL, pick another option.

options.label: I'll type my preferences here
options.description:
✅ Fastest path if you already know which direction you want.
✅ Works when the board URL is not reachable from your machine.
❌ Less structure: I infer ratings and constraints from prose instead of a form.

options.label: I clicked Regenerate or Remix
options.description:
✅ I read feedback-pending.json and generate a fresh round from your remix spec or action.
✅ Board reloads in the same tab so you keep your place.
❌ Adds about 90 seconds and another round of review before passes begin.

D2 — Dashboard mockup comparison board is ready
Project/branch/task: design-ui-project on main, User Dashboard plan review.
ELI10: I generated three visual directions for the dashboard page (Activity Feed main column, Notifications sidebar with unread badge and 'Mark all as read', Quick Actions group, one warm empty state). All three passed the cross-model quality check. I've opened a comparison board here: http://127.0.0.1:41031/boards/b-20260912-031829-qapfw0/ — rate them, leave comments, remix elements you like, and click Submit when you're done. If you clicked Regenerate or Remix on the board, tell me and I'll generate new variants. You can also just type your preferences here.
Stakes if we pick wrong: the chosen variant becomes the visual reference for every remaining review pass, so the wrong direction propagates into the plan.
Recommendation: Submitted on the board because the board captures ratings and per-variant comments in a structured way I can read back.
Note: options differ in kind, not coverage — no completeness score.
Pros / cons:
A) I submitted feedback on the board (recommended)
  ✅ Structured ratings and comments per variant land in feedback.json for me to read
  ✅ Remix and regenerate actions are captured so I can iterate precisely
  ❌ Requires the browser tab; if it didn't open, use the URL above
B) I clicked Regenerate or Remix
  ✅ Lets you steer toward a different direction before committing to one
  ✅ I'll rebuild the board in place and wait again
  ❌ Another 90 seconds of generation per round
C) I'll describe my preference here instead
  ✅ Works without the browser; type which variant and what to change
  ✅ Fastest if you already know the direction you want
  ❌ Free text is less structured than board ratings
Net: any path works; the board gives me the most precise signal.
